entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: A town in the Eastern Domains before the Brothers' War, ruled by the High Council, built atop the buried Elder Dragon Palladia-Mors and destroyed when she awoke.

entities.name: High Council of Mors Ridge
entities.description: Five-member ruling council; all but Arcus and Ham were killed.

entities.name: Arcus
entities.description: Council member who told the Legend of Mors Ridge yearly.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Elder Dragon buried beneath Mors Ridge, kept asleep by a Tickery spell.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Dug above the sleeping Elder, breaking the spell; his army merged with the remaining troops.

entities.name: Army of the Valley
entities.description: Formed from remaining troops and Red Donald's army.

entities.name: Chromium
entities.description: Elder Dragon who listened to the enchanted child.

entities.name: Tickery Man
entities.description: Title taken by the stranger who felled Palladia-Mors.

events.summary: Red Donald digs above the sleeping Elder, breaking the Tickery spell and destroying the town.
events.quote: The spell was broken when Red Donald began to dig above the sleeping Elder, and the town was destroyed.

events.summary: The remaining troops join Red Donald's army to form the Army of the Valley.
events.quote: The remaining troops joined with Red Donald's army to form the Army of the Valley

events.summary: In the legend, an enchanted child finds Chromium and Palladia-Mors in a cave, and the town wizard pronounces the dragons evil.
events.quote: The ignorant town wizard pronounced the dragons evil and rallied the townsfolk.

events.summary: In the legend, Palladia-Mors attacks the town; a stranger casts a spell that makes her fall and becomes the first Tickery Man.
events.quote: a stranger appeared and cast a spell that caused Palladia-Mors to fall to the earth

relations.note: town built atop her buried body
relations.quote: the town was built atop the buried body of the Elder Dragon Palladia-Mors
Arcus , a member of the High Council of Mors Ridge
